name: Exaiphanes Blade
description: A longsword that once shone with the light of the very stars. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.
descriptionRaw: A longsword that once shone with the light of the very stars. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.
story:
Travels are full of meetings and partings.
Perhaps the only trusty and inseparable companions of a Traveler,
Are the sword in their hand and the dream in their heart.

Light, even if it should last but an instant,
Can shatter the eternal night.
And thus, light descended.
